language.name: English
app.name: Neutron Migrator
common.quit_body: An operation is still running. Cancel it and quit?
login.title: Sign in to Proton
login.totp_hint: Enter the current 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
login.mailbox_hint: Your account uses two-password mode. This password unlocks your encryption keys.
login.signing_in: Signing in… this can take a few seconds.
login.need_credentials: Enter your Proton username and password.
login.need_totp: This account has two-factor authentication enabled.
login.need_mailbox: This account requires your second (mailbox) password.
home.title: What do you want to do?
home.download_desc: Copy every photo from your Proton Drive to a folder on this computer.
home.delete_desc: Move your Proton Drive photos to the trash, or erase them permanently.
home.signing_out: Signing out and wiping the local session…
action.found_none: No photos were found in this location.
action.permanent_ack: I understand these photos will be permanently erased and cannot be recovered.
action.free_space: Not enough free space: {free} available, {needed} needed.
error.auth_invalid: Proton rejected the username or password.
error.totp_invalid: That two-factor code was not accepted. Codes expire quickly — try the newest one.
error.mailbox_invalid: That second (mailbox) password was not accepted.
error.human_verification: Proton is asking for human verification (CAPTCHA), which this app cannot complete. Sign in once at drive.proton.me from this network, then try again.
error.fido_unsupported: This account requires a hardware security key (FIDO2) for 2FA, which is not supported here. Add an authenticator app (TOTP) in Proton settings and try again.
error.session_expired: Your Proton session expired. Please sign in again.
error.rclone_missing: The Proton engine (rclone) was not found. Run scripts/fetch_rclone.py, or install rclone 1.65+ and put it on your PATH.
error.rclone_start: The Proton engine could not be started.
error.unsupported_version: rclone {version} is too old. Install rclone 1.65 or newer.
error.network: Could not reach Proton. Check your connection, VPN, proxy or firewall.
error.scan_failed: Your Drive could not be scanned.
error.permanent_failed: Some photos were moved to the trash but could not be permanently deleted. You can delete them manually in Proton Drive.
error.keyring: Your OS keychain is unavailable, so the session cannot be stored safely. It will live in memory only for this run.
login.subtitle: Sign-in happens in your browser on Proton's website. Neutron Migrator never sees your password, 2FA codes or security keys.
login.third_party: This is a third-party application not officially supported by Proton.
login.waiting_browser: Waiting for the browser sign-in to complete…
login.url_hint: If the browser did not open, use this link (it works on another device too):
login.keep: Keep the session on this device (stored in your OS keychain)
action.destination_hint: Photos are saved directly in this folder; name conflicts are renamed automatically.
action.permanent_warning: Permanent deletion removes these photos from the Photos trash. Items whose name is duplicated there are skipped and reported, so nothing else is erased by mistake.
progress.emptying: Permanently deleting from the Photos trash…
error.cli_missing: The Proton Drive CLI was not found. Download it from proton.me/download/drive/cli and put it in vendor/proton-drive/ (or on your PATH).
error.cli_start: The Proton Drive CLI could not be started.
error.cli_command: The Proton Drive CLI reported an error: {message}
error.login_failed: The browser sign-in did not complete. Please try again.
error.not_signed_in: No valid Proton session. Please sign in again.
error.download_failed: The download could not be completed.
error.delete_failed: The deletion could not be completed.
action.include_videos: Include videos from the photo timeline
action.unknown_sizes: {count} items report no size; the total shown is a lower bound.
action.videos_skipped: {count} videos ({size}) are excluded. Tick the box above to include them.
about.ai_assisted: Developed with AI assistance and tested by a human. This app contains no AI and never sends your data to AI services.
